eyebrow.zh: 本地 · 无账号 · 单二进制

headline.zh:
你的编码 agent
跨重启还记得上一次
headline.en:
Your coding agent
remembers across restarts

sub.zh: 你工作时自动捕获每次会话，下次开始时自动回忆最相关的内容 — 按你提过的词与时间远近排序。一个二进制，无需账号和密钥。
sub.en: Captures each session as you work, then recalls the most relevant bits when the next one starts — ranked by what you mentioned and how recent. One binary, no account, no key.

body.zh: 给 agent 加跨会话记忆，过去要挑一个记忆服务、搭向量库、注册账号、申请密钥。automem 把这些全去掉 — 一个二进制，一条命令，无需账号和密钥，全程离线。
body.en: Giving an agent cross-session memory used to mean picking a memory service, standing up a vector DB, creating an account, and getting a key. automem strips all of it away — one binary, one command, no account, no key, fully offline.

body.zh: 一条命令接好 Claude Code 和 Aider — 会话结束自动捕获，新会话开始自动回忆，全程无需手动配置。
body.en: One command sets up Claude Code and Aider — your session is captured on exit and recalled when the next one starts, with no manual config.

chips: › 退出即捕获，开启即回忆

body.zh: 记忆工具不该是黑箱。内置计数器显示已存储与已注入次数 — 注入率一目了然，你知道回忆真的发生了。
body.en: A memory tool shouldn't be a black box. A built-in counter shows stored vs injected — the injection rate is right there, so you know the recall actually happened.

body.zh: 会话之间没有任何后台进程在跑 — 它被唤醒、做完即退出。你的记忆只留在一个本地文件里，从不离开本机。
body.en: Nothing runs in the background between sessions — it wakes, does its job, and exits. Your memory lives in one local file and never leaves your machine.

headline.zh: 离线、无密钥的跨会话记忆

sub.zh: 本地永久免费、Apache-2.0 开源。记忆只留在你自己的机器上。
sub.en: Free and open source (Apache-2.0) locally, forever. Your memory stays on your own machine.

tag.zh: 让任意编码 agent 跨重启记得上一次的离线记忆层
tag.en: The offline memory layer that makes any coding agent remember across restarts
